user.title: Device-owned EchoMuse schedules
user.description: Open the satellite in the EchoMuse controller → Schedules → Home Assistant connection and generate a connection key. Enter the direct controller address (for the HA add-on: http://<HA-IP>:8768), the key and satellite serial. No controller username or password is needed. The satellite must be online with compatible firmware.

reconfigure.title: Update the controller connection
reconfigure.description: Open the satellite in the EchoMuse controller → Schedules → Home Assistant connection and generate a connection key. Enter the direct controller address (for the HA add-on: http://<HA-IP>:8768), the key and satellite serial. No controller username or password is needed. The satellite must be online with compatible firmware.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the scheduler. Check the controller address, connection key and satellite serial, and confirm the satellite is online.

abort.wrong_satellite: The connection belongs to a different satellite

intent_conflict.title: Scheduler voice routing conflict
intent_conflict.description: Another integration replaced EchoMuse timer handlers. Remove the competing override and reload EchoMuse Scheduler before relying on voice timers.
